input_data: PRODCOM production; Comext imports/exports; code concordance; stock changes if available
metrics: absolute residual; relative residual; coverage; unit consistency
pass_rule: PASS if all components mapped, units consistent, residual within source rounding tolerance, and >=95% required observations
fail_rule: FAIL if missing bridge, incompatible units, unexplained residual above tolerance, or fabricated zero for missing
minimum_real_data: At least one product-country-year series with original source files
known_limitations: Domestic use may not be directly observed; stock changes and re-exports may be unavailable

input_data: Monthly turnover/sales; producer prices; labour-market controls; justified instruments
control_calculation: First-stage relevance; 2SLS; reduced-form and structural residual checks
metrics: partial first-stage F; HAC SE; weak-IV diagnostics; residual checks
pass_rule: PASS only if instruments have documented exclusion rationale, adequate first-stage strength and robust diagnostics
fail_rule: FAIL if exclusion restriction unsupported, weak instruments, rank deficiency, or unstable estimates
minimum_real_data: Sufficient monthly observations and valid excluded instruments
known_limitations: Instrument validity cannot be proven by F-statistic alone

input_data: Product-market prices, volumes, sales and HICP cross-check
control_calculation: Reconstruct unit prices; compare turnover/value-volume identities
metrics: price error; index divergence; coverage; seasonal residual
pass_rule: PASS if definitions align and deviations remain within documented source/rounding tolerance
fail_rule: FAIL if price/volume definitions differ or unexplained divergence exceeds tolerance
minimum_real_data: Matched product/time observations for price and quantity
known_limitations: HICP is not necessarily a transaction price for the exact product

input_data: Real GVA/output, capital stock, labour hours/employment, deflators, industry panel
control_calculation: Re-estimate production function; compare published productivity aggregates
metrics: coefficient stability; confidence intervals; residual diagnostics; out-of-sample error
pass_rule: PASS if panel size and degrees of freedom adequate, variables real/consistent, diagnostics acceptable and coefficients stable
fail_rule: FAIL if capital stock absent, mixed price bases, singular design, tiny sample or invalid inference
minimum_real_data: Multi-year industry panel with capital stock and labour input
known_limitations: Production-function coefficients are model-dependent and may be endogenous

input_data: Intermediate inputs, labour compensation, depreciation, taxes, operating surplus, output
control_calculation: Reconcile cost components to published totals
pass_rule: PASS if components reconcile within published rounding tolerance and all material components mapped
fail_rule: FAIL if unexplained residual, double counting, missing major components or incompatible valuation
minimum_real_data: Same-year consistent supply-use/IOT and value-added data
known_limitations: Industry aggregates do not equal product/firm unit cost

input_data: Full symmetric domestic/import input-output tables; output; final demand; value added
control_calculation: Rebuild A=Z*diag(x)^-1 and Leontief inverse; compare published inverse
metrics: matrix residual; inverse residual; condition number; spectral radius; reconstruction error
pass_rule: PASS if accounting identities and inverse agree within published rounding tolerance and matrix is numerically valid
fail_rule: FAIL if only partial supply-use table, inconsistent dimensions, nonpositive output, or excessive residual
minimum_real_data: Complete balanced symmetric IOT for same country/year/classification
known_limitations: Supply-use tables require documented transformation to symmetric IOT

input_data: Real GDP/GVA, capital, labour, investment, prices, energy and controls
control_calculation: Reconstruct historical macro indicators and benchmark identities
metrics: MAE; RMSE; MAPE where valid; residual autocorrelation; stability
pass_rule: PASS if holdout metrics beat predeclared baseline and benchmark identities reconcile
fail_rule: FAIL if leakage, wrong deflator, insufficient holdout or baseline not beaten
known_limitations: Associational fit is not causal explanation

input_data: Treatment/control groups, event date, outcomes, covariates, clusters, pre/post panel
metrics: parallel-trend diagnostics; treatment effect CI; placebo effects; cluster-robust inference
pass_rule: PASS if design pre-registered, pre-trends/placebos acceptable and enough independent clusters
fail_rule: FAIL if no valid comparison group, treatment timing ambiguous, severe pre-trend or too few clusters
minimum_real_data: Case-specific panel with multiple pre/post periods and clusters
known_limitations: Parallel trends cannot be established solely by a non-significant test

input_data: Long historical GDP/price/production/labour series; forecast origins and holdouts
control_calculation: Rolling-origin backtest against naive and seasonal-naive baselines
metrics: MAE; RMSE; MASE; MAPE only if denominators nonzero; interval coverage
pass_rule: PASS if predeclared holdout metrics beat baseline and intervals calibrated
fail_rule: FAIL if leakage, too few rolling origins, wrong frequency or baseline not beaten
minimum_real_data: Long enough series for multiple rolling origins and holdout
known_limitations: Nominal USD GDP mixes real activity, prices and exchange rates

input_data: Technology coefficients, input prices, capacity, labour, energy, demand and constraints
control_calculation: Independent feasibility and objective recomputation; constraint residuals
metrics: constraint violation; objective gap; solver status; sensitivity
pass_rule: PASS if feasible, independently recomputed objective agrees and all constraints within tolerance
fail_rule: FAIL if infeasible/unbounded, coefficients unsupported, or constraints violated
known_limitations: Aggregate energy balances alone cannot define production technology

input_data: Matched multi-market prices, quantities, trade flows, market definitions and concordances
control_calculation: Recompute market shares, trade balances and cross-market identities
metrics: share sum error; trade identity error; concordance coverage
pass_rule: PASS if market definitions and product codes align and identities reconcile
fail_rule: FAIL if incomparable product codes, missing market denominator or inconsistent units
minimum_real_data: At least two comparable markets and product/time panel
known_limitations: Trade flows do not directly equal final consumption

input_data: Opening/closing stock, receipts, sales/usage, orders, lead times, write-offs and costs
control_calculation: Stock-flow identity; reorder policy simulation vs historical holdout
metrics: inventory balance error; stockout rate; holding cost; service level
pass_rule: PASS if stock-flow identity reconciles and policy improves predeclared cost/service objective
fail_rule: FAIL if firm-level movements missing or inventory balances do not reconcile
known_limitations: National accounts inventory changes cannot validate warehouse-level control

input_data: Network nodes/edges, capacities, distances, travel times, costs, shipment origins/destinations
control_calculation: Flow conservation and independent shortest-path/capacity checks
metrics: flow conservation residual; capacity violations; route cost/time error
pass_rule: PASS if topology complete, capacities respected and benchmark routes/costs reproduce
fail_rule: FAIL if only aggregate freight totals or missing network capacities
minimum_real_data: Connected network graph and observed shipment/routes
known_limitations: Freight aggregates do not encode network topology

input_data: Historical risk drivers, event labels/losses, exposures and scenario definitions
control_calculation: Backtest risk forecasts and stress scenarios against realized outcomes
metrics: calibration; Brier score where probabilistic; loss error; exceedance frequency
pass_rule: PASS if predeclared calibration and loss metrics meet thresholds on holdout
fail_rule: FAIL if no realized loss/event data, leakage, or calibration failure
minimum_real_data: Historical exposures and realized outcomes across regimes
known_limitations: Stress scenarios are conditional scenarios, not probabilistic forecasts unless calibrated
